segments.ja419:1.3: Sabbaṃ harassu bhaddante, mañca dāsīti sāvaya.
segments.ja419:2.1: Oropayassu kalyāṇi, mā bāḷhaṃ [bahuṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] paridevasi;
segments.ja419:3.1: Yato sarāmi attānaṃ, yato pattāsmi viññutaṃ;
segments.ja419:3.3: Na cāhaṃ abhijānāmi, aññaṃ piyataraṃ tayā.
segments.ja419:4.3: Na hi dāni puna atthi, mama tuyhañca saṅgamo.
segments.ja419:5.1: Na hi sabbesu ṭhānesu, puriso hoti paṇḍito;
segments.ja419:5.3: Itthīpi paṇḍitā hoti, tattha tattha vicakkhaṇā.
segments.ja419:6.1: Na hi sabbesu ṭhānesu, puriso hoti paṇḍito;
segments.ja419:6.3: Itthīpi paṇḍitā hoti, lahuṃ atthaṃ vicintikā [lahumatthavicintikā (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja419:9.1: Yo ca uppatitaṃ atthaṃ, khippameva nibodhati;

lines: Attano ajjhāsayānurūpaṃ dutiyagāthāya vuttāya sulasā ṭhānuppattikāraṇaṃ paṭilabhitvā “ayaṃ coro mayhaṃ jīvitaṃ na dassati, upāyena naṃ paṭhamataraṃ papāte pātetvā jīvitakkhayaṃ pāpessāmī”ti cintetvā gāthādvayamāha –
Na cāhaṃ abhijānāmi, aññaṃ piyataraṃ tayā.
Na hi dāni puna atthi, mama tuyhañca saṅgamo”ti.
Sattuko tassādhippāyaṃ ajānanto “sādhu, bhadde, ehi upagūhassu man”ti āha.

Sulasā taṃ tikkhattuṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā upagūhitvā “idāni taṃ, sāmi, catūsu passesu vandissāmī”ti vatvā pādapiṭṭhiyaṃ sīsaṃ ṭhapetvā bāhupasse vanditvā pacchimapassaṃ gantvā vandamānā viya hutvā nāgabalā gaṇikā coraṃ dvīsu pacchāpādesu gahetvā heṭṭhā sīsaṃ katvā sataporise narake khipi.
Taṃ kiriyaṃ disvā pabbatamatthake nibbattadevatā imā gāthā abhāsi –
“Na hi sabbesu ṭhānesu, puriso hoti paṇḍito;
Itthīpi paṇḍitā hoti, tattha tattha vicakkhaṇā.
“Na hi sabbesu ṭhānesu, puriso hoti paṇḍito;
Itthīpi paṇḍitā hoti, lahuṃ atthaṃ vicintikā.
Tattha paṇḍitā hotīti itthīpi paṇḍitā tattha tattha vicakkhaṇā hoti, atha vā itthī paṇḍitā ceva tattha tattha vicakkhaṇā ca hoti.
Lahuṃ atthaṃ vicintikāti lahuṃ khippaṃ atthaṃ vicintikā.
Nikaṭṭhe samacetayīti santike ṭhitāva tassa maraṇūpāyaṃ cintesi.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – yathā cheko migaluddako sakaṇḍapuṇṇadhanusmiṃ khippaṃ migaṃ vadhati, evaṃ sulasā sattukaṃ vadhīti.
Sattukāmivāti sattukā iva, yathā sulasā muttā, evaṃ muccatīti attho.
